name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause is redundant. With the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and the hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up), entering the locked room is already forced before the ball can be picked up, so an explicit Existence for target_room_entered repeats what the other clauses already guarantee. Remove the Existence(target_room_entered) clause and keep the Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up) clauses.

texts: Pick up the ball at least once
Enter the locked room before picking up the ball
